title: Remove fixed landing hero path dots
summary: Removed the remaining fixed vertical path dot elements and their CSS/keyframes from the landing hero flow. The vertical path now has only animated path segments and one moving signal marker, eliminating the visible double-dot clash during active path movement.
userVisibleChange: The landing hero flow animation no longer shows overlapping dots on the vertical path; the animated signal is the only path marker.

risks.title: Reduced-motion path is simpler
risks.mitigation: Reduced-motion mode still displays the static path segments while hiding the animated signal, preserving readable structure without the removed stop dots.

timeline.title: Removed path dot markup
timeline.summary: Deleted the three fixed data-dot elements from the hero flow path.

timeline.title: Deleted unused path dot CSS
timeline.summary: Removed fixed-dot selectors, responsive overrides, reduced-motion references, and keyframes.

timeline.title: Verified one-marker path
timeline.summary: Built the site, checked for removed selectors, probed the DOM in Playwright, captured a screenshot, and ran diff checks.

decisions.title: Remove fixed path anchors instead of retiming them
decisions.rationale: The clash could still happen while the moving signal passed near a fixed anchor between active keyframe windows. Removing the fixed anchors makes overlap impossible and keeps the motion hierarchy cleaner.

decisions.title: Keep note dots separate
decisions.rationale: Right-side note dots and card metadata dots do not sit on the vertical animated path, so they preserve callout structure without competing with the moving signal.
